name: Fortune Eater
languages: Languages spoken by the adventurers (typically common

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: (divine, necromancy); Offering the fortune eater a chance to be instrumental in completing a heroic deed releases their component spirits to move on to the afterlife.

traits.name: Unluck Aura
traits.text: (aura, divination, divine, mental, misfortune); 20 feet. A creature entering the area must attempt a DC 23 Will save, rolling the save twice and using the worse result. On a successful save, the creature is temporarily immune to fortune eater unluck auras for 24 hours. On a failure, the creature must roll twice and use the worse result on all checks as long as it is within the aura.

traits.name: Luck Osmosis
traits.text: ⬲ (divination, divine); Trigger A creature affected by the fortune eater's unluck aura has just rolled two d20s for a check and taken the lower result Effect The fortune-eater stores the higher of the two numbers rolled and uses that number in place of their next d20 roll; this is a fortune effect. They can have only one number stored at a time.

traits.name: Team Attack
traits.text: ⬽ Dead teammates coalesce to attack with phantasmal versions of the weapons they used in life. The fortune eater makes a ghostly longsword Strike, ghostly dagger Strike, and ghostly longbow Strike in any order. Each must target a different creature. Their multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ ghostly longsword +17 (finesse, magical, versatile p); Damage 1d8+8 (1d8+8) slashing plus 1d8 (1d8) negative

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ ghostly light mace +17 (agile, finesse, magical, shove); Damage 1d4+8 (1d4+8) bludgeoning plus 1d8 (1d8) negative

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ ghostly longbow +17 (deadly d10, magical, range increment 100 feet, volley 30 feet); Damage 1d8+4 (1d8+4) piercing plus 1d8 (1d8) negative
